caps_version.description: SemVer of the CAPS specification this manifest conforms to.

manifest_version.description: Monotonically increasing integer. Bumped on every published manifest.

supported_caps_range.description: Informational SemVer range string indicating which caps_versions adopters should support, e.g., '>=1.0.0 <2.0.0'. Adopters MAY use this to advertise compatibility expectations and to reject manifests outside the range.

signer_pubkey.description: Ed25519 public key, base64-encoded. Null in pre-release manifests.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON of all other top-level fields. Null in pre-release manifests.

programType.description: Active classification of the program. 'deprecated' entries are retained for transparency but MUST NOT be matched by the decision algorithm (SPEC §3.2).

archivedAt.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the snapshot was captured.

archivedUrl.description: Snapshot URL on web.archive.org or archive.today (incl. ph/is/li/md aliases).

deprecatedAt.description: ISO 8601 date when the program was soft-deprecated. REQUIRED when programType is 'deprecated'.

deprecationReason.description: Human-readable rationale for the deprecation. REQUIRED when programType is 'deprecated'.
